name: text-computing
description: Workspace for deterministic text computing packages.

scripts.build: npm -w @ismail-elkorchi/textfacts run -s build && npm -w @ismail-elkorchi/textdoc run -s build && npm -w @ismail-elkorchi/textpack run -s build && npm -w @ismail-elkorchi/textprotocol run -s build && npm -w @ismail-elkorchi/textconformance run -s build && npm -w @ismail-elkorchi/textpipeline run -s build && npm -w @ismail-elkorchi/textrules run -s build && npm -w @ismail-elkorchi/textcorpus run -s build && npm -w @ismail-elkorchi/textlab run -s build
scripts.lint: npm run --workspaces --if-present lint && npm run -s check:truth && npm run -s check:boundaries && npm run -s check:claims
scripts.check:fixtures: node tools/validate-tokenization-sbd-readiness.mjs && node tools/validate-textdoc-document-model.mjs && node tools/validate-textpack-resources.mjs && node tools/validate-pos-morph-lemma-readiness.mjs && node tools/validate-pos-morph-lemma-feature.mjs && node tools/validate-rule-backed-ner-readiness.mjs && node tools/validate-corpus-tfidf-bm25-readiness.mjs && node tools/validate-conllu-dependency-readiness.mjs && node tools/validate-dependency-parser-readiness.mjs && node tools/validate-dependency-parser-feature.mjs && node tools/validate-retrieval-feature.mjs && node tools/validate-relation-extraction-readiness.mjs && node tools/validate-coreference-readiness.mjs && node tools/validate-multilingual-support.mjs && node tools/validate-performance-gates.mjs && node tools/validate-evidence-schemas.mjs && node tools/validate-toolkit-capability-scorecard.mjs && node tools/validate-support-status.mjs && node tools/validate-task-evidence-reports.mjs && npm run -s check:package-readiness && npm run -s check:downstream-api && node tools/validate-package-release-gates.mjs && node tools/validate-foundation-release-candidates.mjs && npm run -s check:status-docs
scripts.check:quality: npm run check:static && npm run check:fixtures && npm run check:pack && npm run check:publint && npm run check:attw && npm run check:jsr
scripts.evidence:all: npm run -s compare:all && npm run -s check:fixtures && npm run -s coverage:all && npm run -s fuzz:all
